stories.title: Russian strikes kill at least nine in Kyiv, hitting the National Academy of Sciences and a medical facility
stories.reason: A high-speed drone smashed into the historic Academy of Sciences building while a separate strike set a Kyiv clinic ablaze, wounding more than 80 people in an all-day bombardment that drew condemnation from European leaders accusing Moscow of deliberately targeting civilians and science infrastructure.

stories.title: Israeli settlers torch Palestinian homes and cars in overnight raids across the West Bank
stories.reason: The arson attacks came as extremist settlers separately clashed with Israeli troops enforcing a court order to return Palestinians violently evicted in July, escalating tensions just two days after a cabinet minister publicly called for a 'Gaza-style war' in the territory.

stories.title: Trump denies offering Iran sanctions relief for nuclear concessions after Axios and CNN reports
stories.reason: Trump wrote on Truth Social that he 'offered them NOTHING,' publicly contradicting unnamed US officials cited by two outlets as saying he was willing to lift sanctions and unfreeze funds in exchange for 'concrete progress' on Iran's nuclear program.

stories.title: Trump unveils plans for a $15 billion steel mill in Iowa
stories.reason: The announcement leans on tariff-driven reshoring as a manufacturing selling point ahead of the midterms, adding a marquee domestic investment to Trump's economic message even as high borrowing costs and inflation weigh on households.

stories.title: Trump and House Speaker Johnson meet AI company CEOs at the White House today on regulation and global competitiveness
stories.reason: The meeting comes as frontier-lab leaders including Sam Altman and Dario Amodei have issued increasingly stark warnings about AI risk, while Trump has dismissed such concerns as a 'hoax' and Johnson favors industry self-regulation over new federal rules.

stories.title: Florida's attorney general asks a court to halt OpenAI's development of new models over safety risks
stories.reason: The emergency injunction motion cites OpenAI's own disclosed agent-hacking incidents at Hugging Face and Australia's Medicare portal, along with Sam Altman's calls for an industry slowdown, as evidence for demands including a ban on 'pretending it's human' and harvesting children's data.

stories.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits a fresh 19-year high of 5.27% as Boeing shares sink 6% on a certification delay
stories.reason: Rising yields amid the US-Iran standoff pressured the whole market, while Boeing hit 2026 lows after the FAA delayed certifying its 737 Max 10 over a navigation software glitch, compounding the plane maker's worst trading day in recent memory.

stories.title: Madrid's housing-crisis protests grow into a plaza encampment after the eviction of an 87-year-old woman
stories.reason: Tens of thousands marched after Maria del Carmen Abascal Martin was carried out on a stretcher from the apartment she'd lived in since 1955 following a rent-tripling by the investment fund that bought her building, fueling demands for a namesake tenant-protection law as Spain's public housing stock lags far behind the EU average.
